dossier.headline: Wall Street swings between oil relief, hot inflation and an AI rebound
dossier.summary: US stocks have whipsawed this week: the S&P 500 jumped 2.35% on Monday as oil tumbled, its best day since April, then fell about 0.4% on Tuesday after a hotter-than-expected October CPI. On Wednesday it rose 1.31%, with the Nasdaq up 1.60%, as CoreWeave's earnings beat revived the AI trade.
